d: Thousands of students, teachers and trade unionists have taken to the streets across France, demanding better education funding and action against the rising cost of living. Demonstrations erupted in Nantes and Paris on November 10, with student unions vowing to maintain pressure on Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu's government. The protests, which began in September over school renovations, teacher shortages and university reforms, have expanded into a wider movement against economic inequality. Protesters are demanding higher salaries and better conditions in educational institutions.…
